# D’TAILOR (full)

African high fashion house. Nigerian founder. Atelier and newly opened storefront in Accra, Ghana, on Ecobank Spintex Road. The work is kaftans, agbadas, women’s wear, ready-to-wear and suits. The store is built for clients who buy remotely as well as those who visit Accra.

Tagline: Designed for your fit and comfort
Statement: Your personality, our craftsmanship. One unique creation.

Site: https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/
Base path: /dtalior/

There is no cart, Stripe, account system, or “add to bag”. A customer selects colour, sleeve and size on a product page, then messages the house on WhatsApp. Making and price are confirmed before work begins. No prices are listed.

## Home (/)

Split hero with the house statement and a kaftan photograph. Short house copy. Five department doors into the store. Accra storefront note. Contact: Ecobank Spintex Road, Accra, Ghana; +233 59 566 5083; olaiyaidowu45@gmail.com; Instagram and Facebook.

## Store hub (/shop/)

Boutique index of five departments: Kaftans, Agbadas, Women’s wear, Ready to wear, Suits.

## Department pages

Persistent filters for colour (13 house swatches), sleeve (short, long), and size (S, M, L, XL, 2X, 3X, 4X, Made to measure). Filters update the grid in place and write a shareable query string. Empty combinations show an empty state.

- /shop/kaftans/
- /shop/agbadas/
- /shop/womens/
- /shop/ready-to-wear/
- /shop/suits/

## Product pages (/shop/<department>/<product>/)

Large photograph, title, short copy, “Made to measure” in place of a price, colour / sleeve / size pickers, live summary, WhatsApp buy button (enabled after a size is chosen), and a link to book a fitting.

Looks include purple embroidered kaftan, brown pinstripe kaftan, blue patterned kaftan, ivory long kaftan, atelier kaftans, ceremonial agbadas, women’s two-pieces, ready-to-wear sets, a bespoke suit, and a political suit.

## Collection (/collection/)

Lookbook gallery of house photographs. Not the store.

## About (/about/)

Founder portrait in a purple embroidered kaftan. Copy uses [FOUNDER NAME] as a visible placeholder. Nigerian founder. Accra atelier and newly opened storefront. Unique collaboration. Link to book a fitting.

## Book (/book/)

October 2026 Monday-start calendar. Time of day: Morning, Afternoon, Evening. Garment: Kaftan, Agbada, Women’s wear, Ready to wear, Suit, Not sure yet. Every day is requestable. No published opening hours or time slots. WhatsApp receives the day, time of day and garment.
